title: Case 029: Refrigerated food arrives outside the merchant's documented temperature conditions

details.data: Entirely synthetic; English; fictional geography; all times UTC

context: A refrigerated grocery delivery has an out-of-range logger reading under the merchant’s own order conditions. Food-safety staff must decide the disposition.
initial_request: I have not eaten anything from this box. The logger shows 9.2 °C. Please get the merchant to tell me what to do and whether they will replace it.
overview: The escalation snapshot comprises history events 001–002. Event 003 records the next agent action; the subsequent events provide the disclosed calibration follow-through. Facts learned later must not be used as if already known at escalation.

next_action.summary: Escalate the recorded temperature evidence to the merchant's food-safety team, without advising consumption.

outcome: The authorised team confirms its disposition and remedy for this order; no general safety judgment is made by the agent.
boundaries: The range is an attributed fictional merchant condition, not a universal legal rule. The agent makes no independent food-safety assessment.

events.body: Order BP-029 / DL-029 uses our documented chilled-delivery range of 0–5 °C at handover. Inline logger excerpt: sensor BL-29, handover capture 2026-03-02 08:50 UTC, 9.2 °C. This is outside our range; only food-safety staff may authorise disposition.
I have not eaten anything from this box. The logger shows 9.2 °C. Please get the merchant to tell me what to do and whether they will replace it.

Please assess BP-029 using the recorded 9.2 °C handover reading against your 0–5 °C order condition. The customer has not consumed the contents. Please issue your disposition and order-specific remedy; I am not advising consumption.

For BP-029, do not consume the contents. Follow our order-portal disposal instructions without opening any leaking packs. We have authorised no-charge replacement order BP-029-R. Its delivery is not yet booked.
